findings_summary: Both publications ask the same terminal all-m Perfect Prime critical-cofactor question and preserve exact-counterexample as the negative outcome. The 2026-08-26 publication starts from reconstructed mixed-difference/falling-factorial and total-positivity routes; the 2026-08-28 Driver publication records a later exact frontier through m=40 and a signed factorial-Cauchy Laplacian reduction. The later publication is therefore an operationally advanced routing packet, while the earlier publication remains useful provenance rather than disposable duplicate evidence.
